**1. E2B** — ~150ms cold start, $0.05/vCPU-hr, microVM isolation
**2. Modal** — ~200ms, $0.06/vCPU-hr, container-based
**3. Daytona** — ~180ms, $0.05/vCPU-hr, microVM
**4. Replit** — ~800ms, $0.08/vCPU-hr, container
**5. Fly.io Machines** — ~300ms, $0.04/vCPU-hr, firecracker VMs
